reserveReview.rationale: Genuine new whole-direct-reserve review on 2026-10-22; prior classification-only review was 2026-10-07 and its 2026-09-30 block is historical. At Ethereum block 26248000, hash 0xa0e29bc4e36526c9587442208ab78842dc095171147ad5f454f39a3fc7573703, 2026-10-22T11:57:35Z, the active implementation remains 0xb0c63bb1667b6e9215aee562af2957739b2676fe, asset() is YUSD 0x4274cd7277c7bb0806bd5fe84b9adae466a8da0a, cooldownDuration is 604800 seconds, and totalAssets equals the native YUSD balance exactly at 11483489489716643491412671 raw units. The governing ERC-4626/silo code holds YUSD, burns shares into a YUSD cooldown claim, and allows unstake after cooldownEnd; it imposes no fixed maturity of shares. The reserve is a protocol staking claim, not a directly owned BTC hedge or bank deposit. Seven-days describes the wrapper-local ordinary native-YUSD cooldown route, not a hard fiat-settlement maximum; fee-bearing immediate paths and mutable parameters are not newly credited. All YUSD parent synthetic, custody and margin/liquidation constraints remain upstream.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The onchain custodyModel describes wrapper-local custody of deposited YUSD in the Ethereum and BSC sYUSD vault contracts and the Ethereum cooldown silo. On 2026-10-01, asset() identified chain-local YUSD at Ethereum block 26098750 and BSC block 125134867; Ethereum totalAssets() exactly matched YUSD balanceOf(vault). The current Ethereum and BSC implementations reject rescueTokens when token == asset(), and ERC-4626 deposit/mint transfers the parent asset into the vault before minting shares. These implementation constraints do not remove the reviewed proxy-upgrade authority. Under owner ruling D08, YUSD's underlying strategy custody risk remains on yusd-aegis through the existing parent dependency; this wrapper review does not establish upstream custodians, allocations, segregation, bankruptcy protection, or reuse rights. No provider shares are inferred.
